recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-38680 unless the work group chooses a broader editorial pass on extension-pack artifact metadata definitions, which is outside this core reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-38680 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5 MetadataResource. It requested that lastReviewDate be clearly the date last reviewed by the publisher, that reviewer and endorser not be removed but be defined as publisher-asserted rather than local review or endorsement fields, and that standard extensions for such metadata be recognized as already done.
initial_application: Git commit 794ffc14b84f569c88d209a3366675e91b528f01 explicitly applied FHIR-38680 by changing MetadataResource.lastReviewDate to say it was last reviewed by the publisher and changing reviewer and endorser definitions to say they are asserted by the publisher. The same commit propagated equivalent wording to then-current concrete metadata-resource definitions and related source inputs.
additional_context: MetadataResource is active in source/fhir.ini as an interface resource. Later FHIR-39270 work added CanonicalResource localization guidance that all canonical resource elements are original author/publisher assertions and local usage requirements should be captured in separate resources such as List or ArtifactAssessment; MetadataResource comments now link to that guidance. FHIR Infrastructure minutes for 2022-12-19 corroborate the FHIR-38680 persuasive-with-modification vote, and no conflicting later Jira, Zulip, Confluence, or source-history evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no core source change is needed. The authoritative source already conveys the rule requested by FHIR-38680, and verification searches found no remaining obsolete lastReviewDate, reviewer, or endorser wording in non-SVG source.

related_jiras.note: Later Published CanonicalResource conformance guidance reinforces the original-publisher versus local-usage boundary and added the ArtifactAssessment/List localization guidance now linked from MetadataResource elements.
